relationships.statement: "Entries stay after a reload: when an entry exists for today and the page reloads, the entry still appears with its work, its project and its duration." depends on "A person can pick a project for an entry from the short list of Admin, Client work or Internal, and the entry shows the chosen project.".
conditions: R5 requires the entry to still appear with its project after reload; R1 requires the entry to show the chosen project
